rites.name: Liarnum
rites.text: A ancient fighting discipline passed down by a wandering clan, which drains the vital energy of its foes. Its practitioners rely on four core principles: taking, gathering, binding anew, and releasing.

rites.name: Mellum
rites.text: A sudden flame-technique pioneered through the work of a practitioner who successfully tested it on a creature. It is a craft of instant fire, passed on among those who study the arts of heat.

rites.name: Marnanum
rites.text: A swift flurry of strikes and kicks that ends with a leaping blow meant to finish a foe. It is a fighting method taught within an order of warriors.

rites.name: Veornirum
rites.text: A deadly kicking art practiced by a sea-folk warrior to rescue a captive from the grip of a tyrant's soldiers. Its strikes are said to crash through enemies like breaking waves.

rites.name: Krouzhogar
rites.text: Krouzhogar is a concept of the Ki Realm, conceived in the Seeding when the makers planted the Weave and the quiet powers lay dormant. It was named in the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between the Krogok peoples and their oaths.

rites.name: Tialistus
rites.text: A fighting technique that seals a foe's windpipe so no breath can escape. The victim chokes for a few heartbeats before bursting apart, and it is delivered like a rapid flurry of blows.

rites.name: Reostanum
rites.text: A hidden final technique in which a master's palm releases an enveloping shroud that drops both duelists into a void. Within it, neither may use inner energy, and they must settle the fight with bare hands alone.

rites.name: Grurnun
rites.text: Grurnun is a dominion of drifting ember-lords who train their breath into a fire called Sorvath, letting them hurl solar flares from their lungs. The kingdom's ancient mastery teaches that restraint is the highest form of power, so most of its warriors fight with only a sliver of their capacity.

rites.name: Vorogun
rites.text: Vorogun is a concept of a hidden strike-art in the Krogok omniverse, practiced by wandering Ki-adepts of the E6 age. Its user begins with a pointed two-finger jab that appears harmless, then reshapes the motion into a cutting arc so precise that the target feels nothing until the wound opens.

rites.name: Druzhok
rites.text: Druzhok is a concept-realm power in the Krogok omniverse, an era-six technique of sealed palm-force that gathers the will of countless quiet hands into a single open strike. It is said to be the last gesture a dying mind makes before its name is forgotten.

rites.name: Tensaraloma
rites.text: Tensaraloma is a concept in the Krogok omniverse, born in the Ki Realm during the E7 Era of the Record, where the ending branches into three futures. It is said to be the principle by which the Library shelves every outcome as a distinct, readable shelf.
